chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Joining Charlie Barnet's band
summary: He replaced Charlie Miller, drafted, in Barnet's band with Peanuts Holland and Howard McGhee; Andy Gibson arranged.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Now, this would really bring us back to the time you worked with Hot Lips Page, then.
Yeah, I... Well, let me see... Hot Lips... that's right... I went with Charlie Barnet first, before...
Oh, before Lips?
I think I did. Was that '43...
Well, all right, let's try and keep it in order. How did you come to go with Charlie Barnet?
Andy Dickerson was the arranger of the band.
He was a good arranger, too...
Charlie Miller was the original pianist, and he was inducted into the Army. That's how I...
You never said any more... You just quit doing arranging yourself, did you?
Oh yeah. I was mostly taken up with playing. To me it was a matter of survival more or less. So I had to
Ramirez - 93
take a lot of...
Well, when you got with Charlie, Peanuts Holland was in the band.
Peanuts and Howard McGhee.
Well, Charlie really has never had enough credit, to my mind, because he hired far more Black musicians than Benny Goodman ever did.
Oh, my God.
I mean, you know, Garnett Clark used to play with him very early on.

Yeah? I didn't know that. Well, I remember Charlie when he used to come up to... He was a great admirer of Benny Carter. He used to go into the Empire Ballroom, I remember. Well, now, he was stuck for a piano player at the point, and that's the way I came in, you know. It was mostly road...
Mostly road?
We were on the road a lot. Going through Ohio, Omaha...
